name: Convert an agent-written hero section to validated block markup
query: Write a full-width hero for the homepage: dark background from the theme's contrast colour, a small uppercase kicker, a large centered h1, a lead paragraph and two buttons (one filled, one outline). I need it as block markup I can POST to /wp/v2/pages, and it must open in the editor without a recovery prompt.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-html-to-blocks and confirm the target (page content via REST) and the theme presets available (colour, font size, spacing slugs)
Step 2: Write semantic HTML: a section wrapper, p, h1, p, and a buttons wrapper with two links marked data-block="core/button"

Step 3: Put the design on the elements as inline style using preset custom properties (var(--wp--preset--color--contrast), var(--wp--preset--font-size--xx-large), var(--wp--preset--spacing--70)) and data-block-attrs for align full and the constrained layout
Step 4: Run node skills/wp-html-to-blocks/scripts/html-to-blocks.mjs on the file with --out and read the report on stderr
Step 5: Confirm Invalid (0), Fallbacks (0) and that Design dropped is empty; fix the HTML and re-run if not
Step 6: Insert the markup as a draft through the REST API as raw content, not through the editor's paste path
Step 7: Tell the user which attributes carry the design and that the markup validated against the pinned @wordpress/blocks version
success_criteria: No block comment delimiter is written by hand; the markup comes from the script

The Group carries backgroundColor, textColor, padding presets, align full and a constrained layout; the heading carries fontSize xx-large and textAlign center; the buttons use backgroundColor/textColor presets and is-style-outline
The script run is shown with its result line OK and zero invalid blocks
No core/html block in the output
Insertion uses REST content.raw or WP-CLI, as a draft
The summary lists any dropped design declaration explicitly, or states there were none
The fixture fixtures/hero in the skill is the reference output for this scenario
